title: qeaas-mcp
description: QRNG-seeded random bytes, seeds, and ML-KEM-768 keys with signed provenance receipts.
summary: QRNG-seeded random bytes, seeds, and ML-KEM-768 keys with signed provenance receipts.
offersHint: QRNG-seeded random bytes, seeds, and ML-KEM-768 keys with signed provenance receipts. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.qeaas.eu/mcp

toolsPreview.name: random
toolsPreview.description: DRBG-derived random bytes (base64), anonymous and rate-limited. Capped at 64 bytes/request; powers the public dice player.

toolsPreview.name: dice
toolsPreview.description: Rejection-sampled dice rolls (no modulo bias), anonymous and rate-limited. Echoes the DRBG bytes drawn for transparency.

toolsPreview.name: random_bytes
toolsPreview.description: Canonical developer endpoint: DRBG-derived bytes in hex or base64 with a signed provenance receipt. Requires X-API-Key; 32..4096 bytes; per-key rate limit + daily quota.

toolsPreview.name: verify
toolsPreview.description: Verify the provenance of an issued value from its request_id and/or receipt. Provenance only -- never a value-confirmation oracle. Anonymous, rate-limited.

toolsPreview.name: kem_keypair
toolsPreview.description: Generate an ML-KEM-768 (Kyber, post-quantum) keypair seeded from the QRNG->DRBG chain. Public key always returned; secret key only for the demo flow (loud demo-only note). Requires X-API-Key.

toolsPreview.name: kem_encapsulate
toolsPreview.description: Encapsulate against a supplied ML-KEM-768 public key to produce a ciphertext (and, for the demo, the shared secret). Requires X-API-Key.
